author: Contributor 62
about: RH2 reviewer Jonah receives away notices, the operator diagnoses provider refusals, and tokens are pruned when reviewers leave. World phones are online; provider unregistration is simulated on next delivery.

steps.name: Jonah allows notifications and installs RH2 on his iPhone
Jonah also installs RH2 on his online Android tablet
Priya joins the reviewing team on her iPhone
RH2 alerts away reviewer Jonah on both phones
The online phones receive their notifications
Jonah reads the tablet notice to open the waiting room
A day passes before Priya leaves the reviewing team
Priya uninstalls RH2
The next scheduled away alert still uses Priya's saved token
The operator follows Expo's fifteen-minute receipt recommendation
RH2 receives an error ticket and removes Priya's old token
An hour passes before the operator diagnoses the earlier queued notification
The simulated provider reports Priya's unregistration
The next day an administrator investigates a lengthy review
The diagnostic notification mistakenly includes the whole transcript

body.title: Review transcript
body.body:
RH2 review transcript, room 15:
Review segment 1: Jonah: I opened the room invitation and compared the checkout instructions with the task description. Administrator: Please record whether the confirmation page preserves the selected plan and whether the return link leads back to this review room. Jonah: The initial confirmation is visible, but returning from the receipt drops the room selection; the job remains waiting for another reviewer.

steps.name: The administrator checks the receipt fifteen minutes later
The provider refused the oversized payload
The administrator restores RH2's short notice and room link
The corrected notice reaches Jonah's online iPhone
Jonah opens the corrected notice to read the transcript in the console
Jonah finishes his reviews and leaves the team the following day
The operator's delayed old-ticket cleanup finds receipts already expired
Jonah uninstalls RH2 from his iphone
Jonah uninstalls RH2 from his tablet
